selection_rule: Minimum validation macro MAPE within each Ridge representation; no test selection.

limitations: Legacy snapshot: prior backfill, revisions, adjusted prices and constituent selection are not point-in-time verified.
A calendar session does not prove each stored value is an original unfilled observation.

definitions.aggregation: Equal weight per stock and horizon; overlapping origins are not independent observations.
definitions.direction: Exact sign(predicted-origin) == sign(actual-origin); flat is a third class.
definitions.skill: 1 - model_MAE / persistence_MAE per stock/horizon; positive beats persistence; zero denominator excluded.
definitions.prices: Input snapshot price units; MAE/RMSE retained per stock, not averaged across different price scales.
